fields.title: AutoBuddys
fields.description: Smart automotive assistant application for vehicle maintenance and diagnostics. This comprehensive platform helps users track their vehicle maintenance schedules, diagnose common issues, and connect with certified mechanics in their area.
publications: AutoBuddys: A Smart Automotive Assistant. Journal of Automotive Technology, 2023.
Vehicle Diagnostics Using IoT and Machine Learning. IEEE Conference on Automotive Systems, 2023.

fields.title: Analytical Study of Autism
fields.description: Data analysis and research project on autism spectrum disorders with diagnostic tools. This research focuses on identifying patterns in autism spectrum disorders through advanced data analytics and machine learning techniques.
publications: F. Britto and D. R. Kalbande, "Analysis of technological advances in Autism," 2017 International Conference on Inventive Computing and Informatics (ICICI), Coimbatore, 2017, pp. 776-781

fields.title: Track-On-Park
fields.description: Smart parking management system with real-time tracking and reservations. This IoT-based solution helps users find available parking spots in real-time and allows advance booking for hassle-free parking.

fields.title: Mosquito Disease Analysis
fields.description: Machine learning model for analyzing mosquito-borne disease patterns and prevention strategies.

fields.title: Skin Disease Detection
fields.description: AI-powered dermatological condition detection using computer vision and deep learning.

fields.title: Sign Language App
fields.description: Android application for real-time sign language recognition and translation using machine learning.
